privacy_sec1_desc: When you visit the "Smart Tourism" website, we may collect certain personal information such as your name and email address when you subscribe to our newsletter via the footer section. Additionally, we may collect non-personal data like browser types and pages visited through Cookies.
privacy_sec2_desc: All information collected is used solely for the following purposes: improving our services and website user experience, sending updates or travel recommendations to your email (if subscribed), and ensuring website security against malicious activities.
privacy_sec3_desc: We are firmly committed to ensuring the highest level of security for your personal data. We strictly do not sell, trade, rent, or transfer your information to third parties without your explicit prior consent.
